record.kind: marker passive with no PassiveEffects entry; behaviour is a beforeSimulationStart override on the three Lycanroc classes (weather form switch)
record.summary: Passive.LYCANROC has no PassiveEffects entry and no combat effect. Its only behaviour is the beforeSimulationStart override shared by LycanrocDusk, LycanrocNight and LycanrocDay. Before a simulation's entities are built, the Simulation constructor calls that hook for every unit on each player's board with the simulation weather. updateLycanroc picks a target form: weather NIGHT gives LYCANROC_NIGHT, weather ZENITH gives LYCANROC_DAY, any other weather gives none and nothing happens. If the unit is already that form nothing happens; otherwise player.transformPokemon replaces it with the new form (same position, permanent stats carried over, dishes kept, items re-given, synergies recomputed). The form therefore changes only in NIGHT or ZENITH weather and persists afterwards: there is no switch back in neutral weather, and DUSK is only reached by evolving from Rockruff. Forms differ only by synergy types (DAY adds LIGHT, NIGHT adds DARK, DUSK has neither); base stats, ability ACCELEROCK, maxPP 100 and range 1 are identical in the three classes.
triggers: Simulation construction: beforeSimulationStart for each board unit (bench included), before entities exist
